West Bengal Government Argues for Custodial Interrogation in Land Grab Case

The West Bengal government has informed the Supreme Court that custodial interrogation of Sumit Ray, personal secretary to TMC leader Abhishek Banerjee, is necessary in a land grab case. The government stated that Ray deposited a large amount of cash in a bank, which is a key aspect of the investigation into the Salboni land grab allegations. The Supreme Court was informed of this argument by the state.
